default_policy.reason: Fail closed: language availability, store-console selection, or a successful build is never legal approval. Any ISO-3166 alpha-2 country absent from the configured registry is BLOCK.
default_policy.production_invariant: Configured markets require attributable official-source coverage for all 22 legal control families, current/future-law separation, exact country×document-locale legal documents, internally reviewed language scope, and subnational source architecture. Unknown live runtime facts fail closed. Store/provider/operator/registration/account facts remain separate production evidence.

data_localization.scope: Data-localization, in-country storage, mirroring, sectoral hosting and related storage-location restrictions are evaluated independently from representative/establishment duties.

representative_requirement.scope: Local/EEA/UK/etc representative, agent, establishment or local-contact requirements are evaluated independently from data-localization duties.

operator_identity_tax_invoicing.scope: Business/operator identity disclosures; tax/VAT/GST and invoicing/e-invoicing; and digital-service/platform/app business registration, licensing, filing, notification or verification duties are separate subdimensions.

store_platform_obligations.scope: Apple App Store and Google Play obligations are a separate release family and cannot be inferred from general consumer or UGC review.

subnational_requirements.scope: State/province/territory/region/emirate/free-zone/local rules are a separate release family. A national source never substitutes for the required subnational applicability matrix.

applicability_effective_dates.scope: Applicability, commencement, transition and future-law status are independently reviewed. Enacted-but-not-effective and proposed rules must not be treated as current obligations.
